cases.answer: PaymentOps Workbench is a personal project Nitin designed and built independently in 2026. cases.question: What is Ask Nitin and how is it built?
cases.answer: Ask Nitin is the AI assistant on Nitin's portfolio website, a personal project from 2026. Recruiters can ask about his experience and get short answers with citations to his résumé, portfolio and project materials, or paste a job description for a fit report [project-ask-nitin#1]. It is built as a personal project with AI coding agents (Claude Code) in a leader/worker setup. Nitin wrote the step-by-step specifications and ground rules, one agent implemented each step, a second agent tested and reviewed it, and he approved every commit [project-ask-nitin#10]. An evaluation suite gated changes, and the reviews caught issues such as a rate-limit bypass through a spoofed X-Forwarded-For header [project-ask-nitin#10]. The portfolio site is a static HTML, CSS and plain JavaScript site, served by the same FastAPI app at the same URL [project-ask-nitin#9].

cases.question: Which AI models does the Ask Nitin assistant use?
cases.answer: Ask Nitin uses Claude Haiku 5.5 for chat answers, which stream to the browser as they are written, and Claude Sonnet 5.5 for job-fit reports, with structured output validated by a Pydantic schema [project-ask-nitin#3]. The system prompts are prompt-cached [project-ask-nitin#3]. The provider and model names are set in configuration, so another provider can be tried without changing the rest of the code [project-ask-nitin#2]. Ask Nitin is one of Nitin's personal projects from 2026 [project-ask-nitin#1].
